title: Mouse Tissue Fixation with Paraformaldehyde for Fluorescent Reporter Mice
author: Paola Marcovecchio
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.vnge5bw

steps.title: Prepare Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary buffers, ensuring PFA is fresh and protected from light.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 1.6% PFA in PBS (at least 20 mL per mouse; half for perfusion, half for overnight storage). Use PFA no older than 24 hours and store away from light.
Prepare PBS with 2mM EDTA (at least 10 mL per mouse).

steps.title: Sacrifice Mouse
steps.instruction: Sacrifice the mouse using CO2 and begin the procedure immediately after breathing stops.

steps.title: Expose Thoracic Cavity
steps.instruction: Dissect open the thoracic cavity, ensuring the heart is not punctured by scissors or forceps.

steps.title: Perform PBS Perfusion
steps.instruction: Perfuse the mouse with PBS containing EDTA to clear the vasculature.

substeps.instruction: Fill a 10mL syringe with 10 mL PBS with 2mM EDTA and attach a needle.
Insert the needle into the mouse's right ventricle (left side of heart from the user's perspective).
Slowly perfuse until the lungs turn white and the liver turns brown.

steps.title: Perform PFA Perfusion
steps.instruction: Perfuse the mouse with PFA to fix the tissues in situ.

substeps.instruction: Fill the syringe with 10 mL 1.6% PFA in PBS.
Repeat the perfusion process until the mouse appears stiff.

steps.title: Harvest Tissue
steps.instruction: Carefully remove the tissue of interest, avoiding any marks on the tissue.

steps.title: Post-Perfusion Fixation
steps.instruction: Place the harvested tissue in 10 mL of the remaining 1.6% PFA in PBS using a 15 or 50mL conical tube.

steps.title: Incubate Tissue
steps.instruction: Fix the tissue at room temperature in a dark place or covered in foil based on tissue size and application.

substeps.instruction: For larger, thicker tissues: leave overnight (16:00:00 - 20:00:00).
For smaller tissues (e.g., lymph nodes) or tissues requiring antibody staining: fix for 2-8 hours.

steps.title: Wash and Store Tissue
steps.instruction: Wash the fixed tissue with PBS 1x and store at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Wash the tissue 3 times with at least 10 mL (or more) of PBS 1x.
Allow tissue to sit in each fresh PBS wash for approximately 00:20:00.
Place in 4 °C until ready for use.
